cases.remarks: Focus moved from Link 1 to Button1 to browser chrome — no keyboard trap. Tab order correct, focus escapes freely.
Keyboard trap detected: Tab cycles between Link 2 and Button1 indefinitely. Focus never escapes to browser chrome.
SR announced 'Age (years) spin button 0. Invalid value for age. Age must be at least 1.' — error message properly associated via aria-describedby and describes the invalid value.
SR announced 'Age (years) spin button 0' with no error description. Error message exists on page but is not programmatically associated with the input field.
Audio element present with play button (not auto-playing), volume slider, mute button, and time scrubber. User has full control.
Audio element has autoplay attribute with no controls. Audio plays automatically on page load with no mechanism to pause, stop, or control volume.
axe returned bypass as incomplete, but SR confirmed navigation landmark exists — valid bypass mechanism. FIND_NEXT_LANDMARK announced 'navigation' with list of chapters.
axe returned bypass as incomplete. SR confirmed: no skip link, no headings, no main landmark. Only a complementary landmark exists which does not serve as bypass for main content.
axe found no document-title violation. SR announced 'Clementine harvesting season' — title accurately describes page content about clementine harvesting.

axe found no document-title violation (title exists). But SR + content comparison reveals mismatch: title says 'Apple harvesting season' while content is about clementines. Title does not identify page purpose.
axe found no empty-heading violation. SR announced 'Opening Hours heading 1' — heading accurately describes the section content about opening hours.

axe found no empty-heading violation (heading exists). But SR + content comparison: heading says 'Weather' while content is 'We are open Monday through Friday from 10 to 16.' Heading does not describe the section.
axe found no link-name violation. SR announced 'See the description of this product. link' — link text clearly identifies its purpose.
axe found no link-name violation (link text exists). But SR announced 'More link' — ambiguous link text that does not identify the link purpose in context.
Single-character shortcut '+' exists, but page provides a checkbox to remap it with Ctrl modifier. SR confirmed checkbox is labeled and accessible: 'Use ctrl key together with the + key'.
Single-character shortcut '+' is active with no mechanism to remap, disable, or restrict to focused component. Page only has a text input and label — no settings to modify the shortcut.
SR confirmed focus on 'ACT rules' link. Screenshot shows clear visible focus indicator — dark rectangular outline around focused link.
SR confirmed focus on 'ACT rules' link, but screenshot shows no visible focus indicator — no outline, border, or visual change on the focused element. CSS likely has outline:none.
axe found no color-contrast violations. Text is #333 on #FFF (~12.6:1 ratio), well above 4.5:1 minimum.
axe flagged color-contrast violation: ratio 2.32:1 (#AAA on #FFF, 16px normal weight). Required minimum is 4.5:1.
Screenshot shows a photograph (fireworks at Eiffel Tower) — not an image of text. Image contains no rendered text.
Screenshot shows text rendered as a JPG image ('The Accessibility Conformance Testing (ACT) Rules Format 1.0...'). Text should be rendered as actual HTML text, not an image.
Instruction 'Click the button labelled howdy, on the right' uses visual location but also provides the button label — non-sensory alternative present.
Instruction 'Find the menu on the right, to navigate' relies solely on visual location with no non-sensory alternative for identifying the navigation.
CSS has @media (orientation: portrait) with rotateZ(1turn) — a 360-degree rotation that results in no visual change. Orientation is not restricted.
CSS has @media (orientation: portrait) with rotate(1.5708rad) (~90 degrees), forcing landscape layout in portrait mode. Orientation is restricted via CSS transform.
Image of styled 'Ivanhoe' text has descriptive alt text explaining the visual appearance of the text, satisfying 1.4.5
CSS background-image (textimage.jpg) contains text with no alt text mechanism available, fails 1.4.5
Submit button has aria-describedby linking to error message; SR announces 'Name and color cannot be empty. Please complete all required fields.' when Submit is focused
Error message span not associated with Submit button; SR only announces 'Submit button' with no error description when Submit is focused
Links 'HTML', 'EPUB', 'Plain text' are descriptive in context of the Ulysses list item; axe reports no 2.4.4 violations; SR confirms descriptive link names
div with role='link' has text 'More' which is non-descriptive with no additional context; SR announces 'More link' with no context to determine purpose
Element is an anchor with role='button', making it a button not a link; 2.4.4 link purpose rule does not apply
Buttons trap focus but page displays 'Press Ctrl+M to Exit' instruction providing a documented escape mechanism; JS implements escapeTrapOnCtrlM handler
Focus cycles between Button 1 and Button 2 indefinitely with no escape instructions or mechanism; Tab key repeatedly cycles between the same 2 buttons
Page only contains a button with display:none (not focusable); no elements in sequential focus order, rule does not apply
Video element autoplays but has 'muted' attribute so no audio plays; 1.4.2 audio control only applies to audio content, not muted video
Text content is available in a tilted div; content is readable text not relying solely on visual orientation as a sensory characteristic
'This circle is nice' text does not rely solely on sensory characteristics for understanding; the circle visual element uses role='presentation'
'Click the button, for a surprise' identifies the control by its name/label not by shape, color, or position alone
Page contains only a linked image with alt text; no instructions referencing sensory characteristics present, rule does not apply
Black (#000) text on gray (#666) background; contrast ratio ~5.74:1 passes AA for large text (18pt) and normal text thresholds; axe reports no contrast violations
Default link 'W3C' with standard browser styling on white background; axe reports no contrast violations; link text contrast passes AA
Black text with opacity 0.3 on white background; effective color is light gray with insufficient contrast; axe flags color-contrast violation (wcag143)
#777 text on #EEE background; contrast ratio ~3.0:1 fails AA 4.5:1 requirement; axe flags color-contrast violation (wcag143)
Page contains only an image with alt text, no visible text content; 1.4.3 text contrast rule does not apply; axe reports no contrast violations
Disabled button with #777 text on #EEE; disabled components are exempt from 1.4.3 contrast requirements; axe reports no contrast violations
CSS uses 'rotate: 0turn' in portrait media query which normalizes rotation, does not lock or restrict orientation; page content accessible in both orientations
CSS only contains font-size responsive rules with no orientation-locking transforms; rule does not apply
'Opening Hours' heading accurately describes the following section about business hours; SR announces 'Opening Hours heading 1'
'Weather' heading does not describe the section content about business opening hours; heading is misleading/non-descriptive; SR announces 'Weather heading 1'
Page has only an empty h1 with no text content; 2.4.6 applies to headings that describe sections, an empty heading has no descriptive content to evaluate

Title 'University of Arkham' does not describe the page which shows search results for 'accessibility'; SR announces 'University of Arkham' but h1 says 'Search results for accessibility at the University of Arkham'
Nav element with multiple skip links ('Skip to translator's biography', 'Skip to information about the book', 'Skip to main content') provides bypass mechanism; SR finds nav landmark
Nav element with skip links ('Skip to local navigation', 'Skip to main content') provides bypass mechanism; SR announces navigation landmark with skip links
Printable character shortcuts '+' and 'a' are used, but checkboxes allow remapping to require Ctrl modifier; remap mechanism satisfies 2.1.4
Only shortcut is 'Escape' key which is a non-printable character; 2.1.4 only applies to keyboard shortcuts using printable characters, so rule is inapplicable
Page only contains a non-focusable span element; no elements in sequential focus order exist, so 2.4.7 focus visibility rule does not apply
